init.description: Smart heating settings are used when the 'Smart heating control' switch is on. Outdoor temperatures are averaged over about an hour. The mild-day time window is set with the 'Smart heating window start/end' entities and the 'Smart heating mild-day window' switch.

error.warm_below_cold: The warm point must be warmer than the cold point.
error.off_below_mild: 'No space heating above' must not be lower than the mild-day temperature.
